## Does this need an ADR?

This project is **ADR-first**: architectural decisions are written *before* the code
(`.agents/AGENTS.gates.md`). ADRs live in GitHub Discussions under the `ADR` category.

- [ ] No — this is additive and non-structural
- [ ] Yes — an ADR is required first (`cornerstone adr new "<title>"`); link it here once open
